SearchAliases: on the lump of red flesh
on this mass of bare flesh

ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: The phrase marks a bodily surface or site—the top of the red flesh-lump—where Linji places the true person of no rank and Nanyuan Huiyong places a thousand-fathom wall.
EvidenceBody: Its most frequent named deployment quotes Linji: "on the lump of red flesh there is a true person of no rank, constantly going in and out through the face-gate of each of you; those who have not verified this, look, look" (赤肉團上有一無位真人，常在汝諸人面門出入，未證據者看看). The phrase also heads Nanyuan Huiyong's recorded saying, "on the lump of red flesh, a wall stands a thousand fathoms" (赤肉團上，壁立千仞), followed by the cited participant repeating the sentence and overturning the Chan seat. Later records quote both formulations, combine the phrase with the "true person of no rank" (無位真人), and use it as the location of other stated predicates. The broader form "lump of red flesh" (赤肉團) occurs 441 times, while "beside the lump of red flesh" (赤肉團邊) occurs 36 times. No exact occurrence using "inside" in place of "on" was found. The entry preserves the literal bodily wording and the two principal recorded sayings without replacing them with an imported abstraction.
